description: olife_friends (16.10): public play stack (= play.bat public / lab olife play-up --public, dry: a copy of the user's world, own keys, whitelist scope gw-olife-pubtest): the Rust gateway, the auth service and the pack server listen on 0.0.0.0 at the FIXED ports of [play.public] (27750/27751/27752); admin/f2f of every service, world, sandbox and the lab daemon on 127.0.0.1 only (netstat). InfoRequest on the host's LAN address -> ServerInfo (gw_id, ports, sealing key) + Disconnect 19; manifest and /health over the LAN address. A friend's client (F2F 0.32, NO autofill file) types one line 'LAN-ip:27750' (+ #fingerprint) and a whitelisted nick -> discovery -> ticket -> play; /players of the admin shows the LAN address; a nick not on the whitelist -> [whitelist] on the status screen; the auth service down -> [auth_down http 0] -> back -> Повторить -> play; a wrong #fingerprint -> [server_key fingerprint]; a second client with the same nick from the same address replaces the first (Disconnect 12, antifraud: same IP). Test nicks/whitelist/antifraud state are removed at the end.
